effects.l1: Keen eye: + Earth to a general perception Test (1 Chi).
effects.l2: Sharp sense: + Tao level to Tests with one chosen sense (paid in Chi).
effects.l3: Outer eye: ignore the penalty for a lost sense for Tao-level minutes.
effects.l4: Heavenly eye: fully replace a lost sense with the other four for Tao-level hours.
